## By game

### 300: March to Glory (PSP)

`300-march-to-glory-psp`

| Observation | Screen | Evidence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `300-march-to-glory-psp-gamebox-controls` Segmented bronze instruments | `hud` | video_frames, high | [Game Box2002, PSP compilation at 0:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AgKACS46XII&t=7s) |

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**Segmented bronze instruments** (0:07.5, 0:09.5, 0:11.5). Two substantial bronze circular instruments frame the arena at opposite corners. Their rims contain separate coloured segments while the figures move between them.

*Website use.* Put a maker’s adjustable setting inside a stepped, segmented dial. Turn the value inside a steady rim that can still be tapped.

</details>

### 4x4 Jam (PSP)

`4x4-jam-psp`

| Observation | Screen | Evidence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `4x4-jam-psp-gamebox-controls` Direction with closing distance | `hud` | video_frames, high | [Game Box2002, PSP compilation at 13:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AgKACS46XII&t=781s) |

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**Direction with closing distance** (13:01.5, 13:03.5, 13:05.5). A white arrow and distance share one patch beneath the vehicle. As the car advances, the distance falls from 110 m to 83 m to 55 m. Gates and score stay above.

*Website use.* On an outdoor exhibit route, give the chosen stop a bearing and an honest distance from the visitor's chosen start. Clear the travel cue at arrival.

</details>

### Ace Combat X: Skies of Deception (PSP)

`ace-combat-x-skies-of-deception-psp`

| Observation | Screen | Evidence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ace-combat-x-skies-of-deception-psp-gamebox-controls` Contact boxes and radar | `hud` | video_frames, high | [Game Box2002, PSP compilation at 14:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AgKACS46XII&t=841s) |

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**Contact boxes and radar** (14:01.5, 14:03.5, 14:05.5). Small outlined boxes label distant contacts against the sky. A square radar inset contains a bright contact. A dotted line links a circled point and the centre in the last sample.

*Website use.* Give a telescope archive one selected object on both the chart and the main view. Label it at the point of inspection and keep the chart available at higher zoom.

</details>

### Alien: Isolation

`alien-isolation` · survival horror

> Feral Interactive official Linux Collection manual screenshots, capture date/patch unknown. These establish the desktop-port overlay design; manual callout numbers and outer page framing are excluded. A mobile edition must be recorded separately.

| `alien-isolation-opening-study` Main menu | `main_menu` | video_frames, high | [draysonvideo · Alien: Isolation · Main menu](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZioVdjCNwI4&t=7s) |

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**Radial inventory overlay**. Short radial ticks connect bracketed item labels over the still-visible dark station. The top revolver label is a white plate; other options use sparse open brackets and small counts. A compact equipment-status strip sits separately on the left. Large green numbered callouts belong to the manual.

*Website use.* Construct a bespoke command instrument from sparse ticks, label brackets and a single active plate. Avoid filled pie slices by default. Author a sweep into focus and a distinct collapse toward the instrument center; those movements are proposals, not verified here.

**Map overlay**. A fine square grid carries cyan room outlines, red diamond markers, circular objective rings and sparse technical labels. Compact top symbols and right-edge zoom controls surround the map. Objective text is below; noisy display texture runs along the bottom.

*Website use.* Develop a technical project atlas using fine linework and object-specific glyphs, with a detached focus ring and separate detail channel. Keep a coherent display material across navigation, labels and status; invent pointer/focus response without introducing uncontrolled flicker.

**Designer-published overlay specimen montage**. Four inset examples show sparse health segments, radial brackets, a crafting dependency diagram and a large white completion plate. Small component squares connect by thin orthogonal traces beside a narrow resource list. The surrounding white montage dividers are presentation framing.

*Website use.* Build a configurator as an authored instrument: small resource tokens, a dependency drawing and a distinct completion plate. Keep the active step visible in the diagram; design any trace drawing or plate arrival as new movement.

**Hacking interface production specification**. An annotated gray wireframe separates tuning slots, a shrinking timer, input symbols, result symbols and counters. Orange notes define state responses for selected, successful and incorrect inputs and signal conditions. This is a design document, not a running game capture.

*Website use.* Before animating a bespoke control, draw each layer and its selected, success, error and idle roles. Specify material effects and feedback independently; then inspect a working specimen. This sheet supports the authoring method, not a claim about shipped animation.

**Main menu** (0:07.5, 0:08, 0:09, 0:10). On the PC main menu the planetary rim and lower-left list emerge from darkness. A short white vertical block marks Play Game while the planet brightens beyond the list.

*Website use.* Give an observatory archive a dark patch for its action plate. Let sunrise travel across the neighbouring image while the action stays readable.

</details>

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**Lobby and mode menu**. Slanted top navigation tabs share a red active wedge and long underline. The actor stands between hanging team banners with diamond invite sockets. A lower-left mode stack has a description strip projecting to its right above a large clipped Ready plate.

*Website use.* Use a stable scene-led index with a bespoke lower-edge action assembly. A focused category can send its detail strip into the neighboring negative space while the main scene remains anchored. Design a new exit back into the category spine.

**Ping command radial**. A translucent segmented ring surrounds an open center over the battlefield. Small colored command glyphs sit on the ring; a white arc distinguishes a wedge, and the command description is centered inside. The surrounding HUD uses slanted rails and clipped geometry.

*Website use.* Design an optional contextual command instrument with a semantic list equivalent, a detached active arc and a central explanation. Author sweep, cancellation and touch selection deliberately; do not claim observed animation from the still.

**Champion squad presentation**. Three tall banners pair an actor portrait with a narrow stats and badge column. The middle banner has a gold outline and a trophy crest projecting above its top-left corner. Dark clipped title and reward strips span the upper and lower screen.

*Website use.* For a team or project comparison, combine distinct artwork with a common badge and metric spine. Let one earned emblem break the top border. Reserve the ceremonial frame for a meaningful selected or featured state.

**Legends index**. Two compact rows of slanted portrait tiles sit under a large character heading. White caption rails share the tile angle, while unowned portraits are muted with lock marks. The large character and raven fill a separate right plane over hanging banners.

*Website use.* Create a compact oblique index beside an oversized project artifact. Derive the tile angle, name rail and section navigation from one drawing rule; keep the preview handoff separate from focus ornament motion.

**Title screen** (0:23, 0:24, 0:25, 0:26). On the Season 1 Xbox One X title, a white arc turns under the mark on a red field between three figures. A dark bordered Continue button appears below the arc while it is still visible.

*Website use.* Show the exhibition poster while checking admission. Enable its single entrance as soon as the check succeeds.

</details>

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**Main menu**. Slightly rotated black sheets have thin uneven white borders. A yellow exterior arrow and yellow condensed label select Continue Story; a separate statistics sheet overlaps the menu below. White splatters escape the stack over Batman and a huge moon. Detail text uses a contrasting serif.

*Website use.* Give each project a skewed paper tab carrying its name. On focus, reveal an inked backing sheet around the tab while its label and hit area stay put. Author the entry and fold-away independently.

**Waynetech upgrade selection**. Small square category pictograms form a long rail. The active upgrade expands into a large yellow-edged illustration below the rail beside chained locked cards. A skewed description sheet and title strip occupy the left. White splashes extend behind the top tabs.

*Website use.* Use a compact symbol index with a larger illustrated specimen projecting into its own lower plane. Differentiate selected, available and locked information through drawing and material; invent a separate expansion/retraction response.

**Character bios contact sheet**. A rotated white contact sheet has rough black portrait windows and ink splatter. The selected portrait is yellow with offset broken corner marks; a separate black nameplate hangs below the sheet with an exterior arrow. Dotted guide lines cross the composition.

*Website use.* Draw an original project contact sheet with a caption physically attached outside its silhouette. Focus can extend corner marks into the page gutter while the caption changes on a separate trajectory. Motion must be designed anew.

**Save slot to main menu and exit confirmation** (0:01, 0:02, 0:03, 0:04, 0:12, 0:13, 0:14). The save sheet sits over the bat emblem at 0:01. By 0:02 the action list has appeared over the chest with Continue Story highlighted. At 0:03–0:04 Batman's profile is framed against the moon and the list remains at the left. At 0:12–0:14 the highlighted exit choice gives way to a two-choice dialog over a dimmed list.

*Website use.* Open the new list immediately when entering an archive. Let the camera complete its move from the cover to the reading table behind the list.

</details>

| `clair-obscur-expedition-33-skills-anatomy` Expedition 33 skill network | `progression` | static_image, high | [Expedition 33 skill network](https://interfaceingame.com/screenshots/clair-obscur-expedition-33-skill-tree/) |
| `clair-obscur-expedition-33-pause-anatomy` Expedition 33 cutscene pause | `pause` | static_image, high | [Expedition 33 cutscene pause](https://interfaceingame.com/screenshots/clair-obscur-expedition-33-pause/) |
| `clair-obscur-expedition-33-inventory-anatomy` Expedition 33 inventory tabs and floating detail | `inventory` | static_image, high | [Expedition 33 inventory tabs and floating detail](https://interfaceingame.com/screenshots/clair-obscur-expedition-33-inventory/) |
| `clair-obscur-expedition-33-merchant-anatomy` Expedition 33 merchant controls | `shop` | static_image, high | [Expedition 33 merchant controls](https://interfaceingame.com/screenshots/clair-obscur-expedition-33-store/) |
| `clair-obscur-expedition-33-opening-study` Title screen | `title` | video_frames, high | [The Gaming Archive · Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 · Title screen](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=izdSFZOnQmo&t=3s) |

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**Expedition 33 victory result screen**. Gold serif result labels float over a dramatic tilted environment. Dry-brush black fields and faint geometric texture gather behind information. A small character portrait diamond projects above the edge of its irregular progress plaque. Statistics and loot occupy separated corners rather than identical cards.

*Website use.* Design a completion or case-study result as a composed scene. Let a small portrait or emblem break its plaque boundary, and use textured irregular information fields to guide attention. Invent a deliberate reveal order for heading, emblem, and outcomes instead of animating the whole page at once.

**Expedition 33 character selection**. Three tall dark portrait plaques have chamfered upper corners and worn borders. Character cutouts, names, health rails, and large levels share the same vertical rhythm. The plaques overlay the actual scene rather than a separate generic grid surface.

*Website use.* For choosing a collaborator, service, or project route, draw a consistent family of worn plaques with intentionally cut corners. Let a larger scene subject remain behind them. Give the chosen plaque an independent marker or extension; a lift or portrait lean would be a new motion experiment.

**Expedition 33 skill network**. Connected diamond nodes span the left and center over a large character portrait. Locks, images, and numeric costs distinguish node states. Small skewed portrait selectors project along the top, while right-side information uses torn dark paint fields, gold serif headings, and a radar chart.

*Website use.* Make a capability or learning-path map a drawn network that belongs to its hero illustration. Distinguish available, active, and locked nodes through meaningful anatomy, not color alone. Let a selected node hand off to an irregular detail plaque without turning the whole composition into boxed dashboard tiles.

**Expedition 33 cutscene pause**. A blurred cutscene remains visible between black letterbox regions. A small serif Pause label sits inside a fine interrupted frame at center. Continue and Skip labels sit near the lower right beneath separate outlined keycaps. This capture is a cutscene pause, not the inventory navigation.

*Website use.* A cinematic pause can keep its subject visible and reserve a single authored frame for status. Reuse the same fine line and key-label anatomy as the larger interface, so a quiet state still belongs to the visual system. No blur transition or exit timing is established by this image.

**Expedition 33 inventory tabs and floating detail**. Elongated tabs and item labels have pointed or cut ends with distressed outlines. The active category has a muted plum fill. A separate item-description sheet floats at right with an irregular brush lower edge. Paint streaks and faint geometric texture unite the black background.

*Website use.* Give category tabs an original pointed contour, then let the item label hand off to a detached information sheet using the same drawn edge vocabulary. Specify the sheet's unfolding and separate closing gesture as original motion, keeping the source's visible geometry distinct from proposed behavior.

**Expedition 33 merchant controls**. An illustrated merchant anchors the right. Item, stock, and price align on long pointed dark strips. Lower actions use small trapezoid-like plaques with distressed thin outlines; their keycaps hang below the plaque boundary. A floating item-description sheet repeats the torn-paint contour.

*Website use.* Construct a commerce action from distinct plaque, label, hanging shortcut marker, and contextual art. The marker can move independently outside the visible plaque while a stable hit area stays intact. Tie the selected item to a characterful presentation rather than a generic product-card grid.

**Title screen** (0:03, 0:04, 0:05, 0:10). Pale and red flecks shift around a centred gold title. The invitation below is bright, nearly disappears, then brightens again while the wordmark holds position.

*Website use.* Animate flecks of glaze around a ceramics collection. Keep the actual collection button at full reading contrast throughout.

</details>

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**Colin McRae Rally 2.0 main menu**. Small repeating lettering traces a closed course-like loop at center on a muted blue field. The lower menu is a continuous oversized lowercase text ribbon separated by fine vertical rules, clipped at both sides; the selected word is bright white. Small title and timer sit in opposite upper corners.

*Website use.* Arrange readable chapter buttons along a route that matters to the site. Enclose each name in a clipped ribbon and let the selected ribbon lift away from the route. Design any movement independently of the still.

**Colin McRae Rally 2.0 options**. The blue field and oversized lower chapter ribbon remain. A small settings list uses thin horizontal dividers and boxed chevrons; the selected row brightens its lettering, arrow and adjacent lines. Most of the screen remains open.

*Website use.* Set each menu label inside a dark instrument plate with a fine metal rim. On focus, brighten the rim and then the face. Let those layers dim separately on exit while the plate stays visible.

**Colin McRae Rally 2.0 driver tag entry**. Widely spaced lowercase letters form an open on-screen keyboard without individual key boxes. The selected letter is bright white among muted letters; entered initials sit alone above. A breadcrumb-like upper-left label uses thin separators and emphasizes the current step.

*Website use.* For a short playful naming or filtering interaction, draw a letter field with a separate selection glyph and an isolated output line. Preserve normal text input and keyboard behavior in the website; any letter displacement or echo effect is an original proposal.

**Colin McRae Rally 2.0 car selection**. Front and rear car elevations appear as dark technical line drawings, alongside a tiny livery image and segmented white performance bars. The lower type ribbon uses vehicle names; the selected name is bright. Small upper metadata leaves the technical drawing as the center of attention.

*Website use.* Give an equipment or project selector original technical elevations and a miniature material swatch, with selection carried by a text ribbon. Let a new focus stroke trace part of the drawing before the facts appear; this motion is a proposal, not observed game behavior.

**Main menu** (3:02, 3:09, 3:12, 3:21, 3:27, 3:49). On PlayStation a dotted English flag accompanies the language selector. At the main menu Rally stays bright in the low horizontal strip as a bright point travels around a dotted route above it. A later driving shot carries a demo label.

*Website use.* In a walking-tour index, let a point trace the selected route on its map while the route button stays still. Offer the visitor direct access to the walk.

</details>

**DiRT Rally 2.0 Service-area preparation menu**. The car and service tents fill the scene. A compact left list uses a solid white selection bar; a long lower information rail pairs an oversized italic ordinal with weather, surface and start data.

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**character select** (0:00, 0:04, 0:11). Across sampled playback states at displayed 0:00, 0:04, and 0:11 the numbered red selection disc changes roster position while the large foreground fighter and tall background portrait strip change together. The lower roster and central brush medallion remain in place. At 0:04 a foreground Goku and a smaller previously selected blue-haired fighter coexist; by 0:11 Tien occupies the preview.

*Website use.* Propose a project picker in which a small navigational emblem changes location while a large figure and tall editorial strip replace together. Keep the rest of the stage steady so expressive previews do not make the whole page unstable.

**character select**. The roster is a foreshortened three-row field across the lower screen. Portrait cells have slanted contours and gold edges; numbered red/blue discs sit over chosen portraits. Large cutout fighters rise far beyond their cells, with pale oversized portrait strips behind them. Color selectors float beside the fighters. A hand-drawn red title sits high in the central gap.

*Website use.* Propose a project selector with a shallow perspective deck and a slanted, framed portrait tile for each project. Deepen the chosen tile's edge and let its cutout preview escape the deck. Keep the clickable regions stable and design the movement independently.

**options menu**. A compact dark translucent options box sits on an enormous game logo, orange grid, and sweeping rough brush loop. The selected row uses white text, an amber horizontal glow, and a round orange marker projecting left of the text. Unselected labels are yellow. The box header has irregular white lettering and overlapping small golden diamonds.

*Website use.* For a small utility menu, draw a bespoke scene-sized ink orbit and use a detached object as focus marker. Propose an asymmetric wipe beneath the active label while keeping the text stationary; do not attribute that proposed wipe to the game.

**story arc select**. Three tall image panels sit above a blue map grid. The active panel is in full color with an intense gold perimeter and paint splashes escaping the frame; two other panels are dark and monochrome. A black rough-edged caption slash cuts diagonally across each panel's lower edge. Bottom navigation uses long slanted gold-edged plaques; side arrows float apart from the panels.

*Website use.* Give each portfolio chapter poster a title on a framed paper tab that crosses its border. Let focus ink escape the mask while the link target stays still. On touch, offer labelled Next and Previous buttons. An outward ink burst and inward fold would be original motion.

**arcade course select**. A broad black scanlined panel spans the screen over a green perspective grid. Selected course text is carried by a thin amber trail fading across the left list, with a small orange sphere at its leading edge. The right side uses diamond portrait tokens and oversized stage numerals. Interlocking gold diamonds flank the central heading.

*Website use.* For a dense chooser, pair a detached leading emblem and a long tapering highlight with a separately composed detail canvas. Use diamond badges as a route/progress language, not arbitrary decoration on every control.

**lobby avatar customization**. A long black title banner with an oblique clipped end occupies the top left. The main body has a wide gray scanlined list and a narrower ornate preview window; a currency capsule sits above. The selected row has white lettering, a long amber band, and a spherical marker outside its left edge. The preview contains a character against the actual colorful lobby environment.

*Website use.* For product/configuration tools, keep the list information dense but let the preview inhabit a small authored world. Build a shared clipped-banner and detached-emblem system across the whole page, then separately prototype selection handoff and preview replacement.

**Lobby entrance** (0:02, 0:06, 0:16, 0:24, 0:30). A short orange logo sting gives way to a dark loading screen. A floating entrance appears behind the instructions. The amber OK surface stays in place as the teaching text changes. By 0:30 the avatar is standing at the entrance.

*Website use.* If a visitor enters a 3D exhibition, let them see the actual doorway behind its one-off control hint. Leave the entrance in the same spot when the hint closes.

</details>

*Website use.* Compose a team or case-study introduction as story, structured facts and a large grounded subject. Redraw the selector as an authored physical prop linked to that story. Transfer this compositional relationship rather than treating the white selector as a novel button.

**Main menu** (3:26, 3:30, 3:37, 3:45). Switching from FC News to Tournaments keeps the mode list on the left and replaces the feature image and green entry button. In Customise the white filled selection moves from EA SPORTS Music to Settings while other tiles stay dark.

A blue message plaque sits above them; a gold level label and flare elevate the right sprite. Large serif title and very fine geometric inscriptions surround this small central ceremony.

A blue/red chronological rail stretches along the bottom, with a detached ornamental chapter label above its diamond. The right detail plate mixes tiny pixel characters with serif headings.

*Website use.* Turn a project history into an authored atlas with original tokens for collaborators, phases, and decisions. Put the current chapter label outside its timeline rail and reveal a specimen card beside the chosen event. Define new movement through the map and distinct outward annotation entry/exit; preserve direct chronological navigation on mobile.

*Website use.* Give a returning visitor a readable Resume button against a stable area of the art.

*Website use.* Define a project-specific poster grid with a featured square and subordinate strips, then deliberately draw focus art beyond that grid. Treat the listed dimensions as this source guide’s units, not mandatory responsive web dimensions. The production guide proves compositional intent, not runtime behavior.

**Forza Horizon 5 Buy and Sell menu**. The selected central Autoshow poster extends beyond adjacent columns and has a white plus magenta exterior contour. Oversized yellow condensed lettering sits over its car photography; side tiles use turquoise, deep plum and white botanical watermark fields. The Forzathon wordmark and tiny hanging shop tag are drawn artwork rather than plain button labels.

*Website use.* Give each service a photographic poster with its name printed once on the face. On focus, lift the chosen poster from the wall while its link target stays in place. The movement is an original proposal.

**Forza Horizon 5 Garage menu**. The main My Cars poster is framed by a projecting white/magenta selection edge. Large condensed labels occupy different tile sizes: left stacked actions, central image title, right collection tile and four thin utility strips. A small yellow numeric tag occupies the collection corner; background blur separates the car scene from the typographic poster stage.

*Website use.* Give portfolio categories different graphic roles rather than uniform cards: a hero image poster, stacked editorial actions and compact utility tickets. Keep their type, edge rail and notification flag part of one authored language. The active contour can travel separately from its image and label.

**Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure production mode-state sheet**. Two rows of mode posters show locked, incomplete and completed artwork. Locked art is monochrome with a lock footer; incomplete art retains vivid mode color; completion coats the entire poster in gold with a separate checkmark footer. Bold slanted Rally/Race wordmarks have black extruded bases and diagonal lower edges.

*Website use.* Author completion as a whole illustration treatment with a separate status stamp, not merely a tiny green badge. Design a custom wordmark for each content mode while keeping its geometry related. These are production state variants; no transition between them was inspected.

**Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure race-mode choice**. A yellow heading flag sits above two tall posters over a blurred scene. The right selected poster is taller and wider, with white/magenta exterior rails. Its gold-tinted completed artwork, extruded slanted wordmark and gold checkmarked footer form separate graphic layers; a dark description shelf hangs beneath the pair.

*Website use.* Create a two-path website entry with original illustrated posters, a detached heading flag and contextual description shelf. Keep completion artwork separate from selection artwork so both meanings remain legible. Author a custom forward emphasis and an independent contour return on blur.

**Title screen** (0:22, 0:24, 0:29, 0:34, 0:40). The lower-right logo, Start Game and Accessibility/Settings prompts hold position through flower fields, jungle, a wet street, a dusty off-road scene and a night festival.

*Website use.* In an outdoor guide, present places in a short changing sequence. Keep Open guide and viewing preferences together and available from the first view.

</details>

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**online lobby**. An avatar stands on timber in a floating-island plaza with a Game Center building and small arcade machines below. The bottom-right guide inset shows a four-direction cluster of blue diamond controls around controller symbols: communication, player list, inspect, and jump. Narrow cut-corner ribbons label actions. *Website use.* For a navigable project world, propose distinct spatial landmarks and a small authored diamond command fan near the active object. Design its entry as a mechanical unfolding proposal; do not misread instructional callout boxes as the game's own UI.

**character select** (0:24.02, 0:29.02). At 24.02s a compact central grid of tall portrait strips is flanked by large fighters and translucent portrait backdrops. <details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**Hi-Fi Rush main menu**. A tilted red panel has uneven cut edges, black slash rails above and below, and thin offset linework outside its contour. The selected yellow row carries a separate white arrow projecting from its left edge. Outlined white labels and a black description shelf sit over the illustrated room.

*Website use.* Set each project name on a cut-paper plate. On selection, let an offset sheet of contrasting ink show around its edges. Carry the diagonals into the project image and design the paper movement independently of the stable hit target.

**Hi-Fi Rush returning main-menu state**. The returning-state capture adds Continue above New Game while retaining the irregular red panel, yellow selected band, separate white arrow, and lower black caption shelf. The menu grows within its existing illustrated assembly.

*Website use.* Give a project index or application launcher a return-aware first action without replacing its art direction. Accommodate extra rows by extending the drawn panel and its edge accents. These two stills show alternative states, not a verified transition between them.

**Hi-Fi Rush skill-store category cards**. Four slanted category panels sit on a skewed stage. The bright selected panel's character extends past its upper and left boundaries. Black torn caption shapes overlap the lower edges; white italic labels and red exclamation markers provide additional layers. A separate irregular white information plate spans the bottom.

*Website use.* For service or project categories, build slanted windows whose original artwork can project outside the card. Give label, cutout subject, notification mark, and information plate separate layers. Propose one controlled outward gesture and a distinct fold-back exit, rather than scaling the whole card.

**Hi-Fi Rush options controls**. Angled top tabs share rough offset outlines; the active tab is yellow. A white arrow sits outside the selected settings row. Label and value form aligned columns while a yellow explanation heading occupies a separate right field. Red cut-line accents frame the dark panel.

*Website use.* Give settings and category tabs the same slanted paper plates as the project selector. Reveal a second sheet around a focused control. Put help beside a setting when someone needs it to understand the choice.

**Title screen** (0:18, 0:19, 0:20, 0:25, 0:44). On Xbox Series X a black frame gives way to a brilliant blue city and an angular white wordmark left of centre. A short slanted black plate protects the invitation beneath it. That plate holds its place against the detailed scene.

*Website use.* For a record shop, derive the browse button from a sleeve sticker. Its opaque fill can keep a normal-size label legible against a complex print.

</details>

*Website use.* Make an interactive product or personal object explain the website's navigation. The object, detached utility rail, and contextual choices can share a consistent material and response language, through a new project-specific interpretation of spatial navigation.

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**original PS4 main menu**. A compact stack of slanted freestanding blue text sits within a large illustrated space scene, without enclosing button boxes. The upper entry is larger and gray. The logo and toy-like floating cosmic objects own much of the composition; controller prompts balance the lower corners.

*Website use.* Use original scene objects and a strongly drawn type stack as the navigation identity. Selection can change the text silhouette without adding a standard card container. Any orbit, letter motion or menu transitions must be designed and validated anew.

**original PS4 character roster**. A dense grid of bronze-ringed circular portraits overlays the visible game scene. The selected top-left token grows beyond the grid spacing with a blue ring. A much larger matching portrait token sits separately above the grid, with a red status caption. Unknown and locked entries retain the circular geometry with different interior marks.

*Website use.* For a collection index, author token-like circular miniatures, a detached hero token and a consistent status-mark vocabulary. Preserve navigation clarity on small screens by reflowing the collection; do not copy a dense game roster unchanged into a website.

**original PS4 character creator**. The huge assembled character stands inside an open physical machine chamber. Small circular category tokens float directly over its lower body, and detached up/down chevrons bracket the central item. Name and code are light slanted captions near the lower-left edge; no full settings panel separates the character from its controls.

*Website use.* In a product configurator, place labelled moulded buttons near the part they change. Seat the chosen button in a recessed socket and show the corresponding piece snapping into the assembly preview.

**Main menu** (1:36, 2:04, 2:20, 2:23, 2:26, 2:35). The logo and lower start prompt hold over moving space imagery. In the resulting list Options is enlarged and pale among blue neighbours. A controller diagram fills the screen, the list reappears with View Trailer enlarged, and a trailer follows.

*Website use.* An exhibitions archive can enlarge the fill inside the currently focused placard without moving neighbouring buttons. Keep the exhibition list available on return from its film.

</details>

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**episode/story select**. Episode options are presented as narrow comic-cover spines on cream production paper; one Knights of Doom cover is expanded wide. Cyan trim guides, handwritten signatures and margin scribbles remain visible. Narrow options use vertical team mastheads and portrait crops. Progress strips sit beneath the covers; a large circular completion stamp overlaps the expanded cover art.

*Website use.* Give each project a printed spine with its title set into the binding. Make the whole spine the control that opens its editorial cover. Design the spine opening and the cover folding shut as separate movements.

**All Star Arena route confirmation**. A hexagonal route network occupies the left on cream paper, while enemy and stage information forms a right column. A white route hex has cyan outline and dotted fill; an adjacent hex is orange. The CONFIRM sheet projects in from the lower-left at an angle and is clipped by the viewport. Its selected Route A row is an orange textured strip. Large tightly packed black headings unify map and dialog.

*Website use.* For a multi-step creative brief, propose a route map with a corner-entering proof sheet; let the chosen route tint its node and confirmation strip. Keep the page’s drawing logic coherent through hard ink borders, printed dots and original type treatment.

**training instructions/combat overlay**. The left instruction stack uses compact individual cream strips, with completed lines yellow and a detached red triangular marker pointing at the current line. The top health bars have long angular ends; bottom resource cells repeat the slant. A large yellow hit count and black/white text sit over horizontal brush-like speed slashes on the right.

*Website use.* Set the current task on a loose paper strip with its action on an inked plate. Confirm the result with a brief stamped status while keeping the action legible and usable.

**character select — TGS 2025 preview** (0:00.800, 0:01.200, 0:06.500, 0:07.000). At 0.800s a small two-row gray portrait grid sits between empty outlined paper panels. By 1.200s selected P1/P2 portraits project beyond their cells as tilted orange/blue cards; large matching slanted color boards and condensed name strips occupy the side panels. At 6.500–7.000s Ghost Rider and inverted Spider-Man models fill those boards and move in place. Cyan crop-guide marks persist.

*Website use.* Propose selectable index portraits that physically slip out of the printed grid, with a larger off-register board and separate name strip sharing the selection color. Author web retraction and rapid re-entry explicitly.

**Main menu** (1:17, 1:20, 1:30, 1:50, 2:28, 2:58, 3:28). Language Setting uses a warm filled row against a light field, then a confirmation card in the middle. The title pairs its logo with illustrated fighters. After the instructional encounter, the main menu makes room for a large image and a compact list of destinations.

*Website use.* In a comic archive, use a clear, quiet panel for a one-time language decision. Save the full illustrated spread for choosing which collection to explore.

</details>

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**main-menu**. A narrow translucent blue column sits left of center over a city scene; a large character fills the right. Navigation is uppercase. The cyan selected row has a thin rectangular outline and small technical marks. A help-text block and smaller promotional card occupy the column below navigation. ESC appears in the corner.

*Website use.* For a portfolio or product landing page, combine a compact opaque navigation/content rail with a large original hero illustration. Use a strong focus outline, concise supporting copy and a secondary feature card. On mobile, stack text above imagery and use semantic navigation; keep imagery behind no essential text.

**map-legend**. A red full-width top strip contains navigation tabs and a level/XP block. Dark navy fills the main surface. A cyan heading sits above three columns of icon-and-label rows; the selected row has a cyan border and tinted fill. Thin horizontal rules divide rows. A bottom resource strip and keyboard prompts frame the content.

*Website use.* Translate this into an analytics dashboard or project browser with a restrained accent header, dark content surface, labeled filters and a clear selected state. Use actual checkbox controls where filtering is needed, preserve keyboard focus, and collapse the three-column content into a single column at narrow widths.

**Pointer crosses from View Credits to Settings** (0:00.05, 0:00.20, 0:00.40, 0:00.60, 0:01.40, 0:01.45, 0:01.55). The small diamond switches from View Credits to Settings and the help copy changes. The letters stay in place while the corners spread towards the ends of the row and a darker face appears. The next panel is wider, with Game current and a fresh set of corners forming.

*Website use.* On a fixed instrument-panel button, change the filled face on intent and let a second detail settle. On activation, give the destination its own panel immediately.

</details>

*Website use.* Place each category label in a dark enamel plate with a luminous rim. Let light branch out from the selected plate and retract on exit. The timing and movement are original proposals.

**broadcast post-match scoreboard**. A mirrored dark scoreboard pairs tall condensed team/player type with portrait pairs and equipment grids. Handwritten orange Victory/Defeat labels interrupt the rigid statistical layout at the top.

*Website use.* Original proposal: a dashboard recap can contrast a carefully typeset metric grid with a custom victory-mark or hand-drawn headline. Do not reproduce game/player imagery or treat broadcast graphics as client behavior.

**in-match equipment shop**. A translucent shop overlays the battlefield. Left categories use text rows; the selected Attack row is bright blue. Equipment uses circular art medallions, with the selected green sword ringed in gold. A connected build tree occupies the right.

*Website use.* Original proposal: for a service configurator, place authored medallion controls beside a diagram showing what the choice changes; retain one strong selected ring while decorative traces can extend outside the hit area.

**Lobby entrance** (0:10, 0:17, 0:23, 0:26, 0:30). A red Match Up Mode button sits immediately under the central model of a battlefield. While matchmaking time advances in the blue strip above, the map and action remain in place. The next view replaces the map with a stage, round hero portraits and a separate OK surface.

### Papers, Please

`papers-please` · simulation

> Official developer desktop presskit screenshots, English, 1140 by640. Exact capture build/date unknown. Phone/tablet adaptations differ and were not inspected.

| Observation | Screen | Evidence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `papers-please-stamp-anatomy` desktop inspection stamp control | `hud` | static_image, high | [desktop inspection stamp control](https://www.papersplea.se/presskit/) |
| `papers-please-endless-anatomy` desktop endless mode selection | `mode_select` | static_image, high | [desktop endless mode selection](https://www.papersplea.se/presskit/) |
| `papers-please-night-anatomy` desktop end-of-day ledger | `results` | static_image, high | [desktop end-of-day ledger](https://www.papersplea.se/presskit/) |
| `papers-please-opening-study` Title screen | `title` | video_frames, high | [Chocoholie · Papers, Please · Title screen](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xT7rbohRzAs&t=10s) |

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**desktop inspection stamp control**. Two raised red and green stamp mechanisms share a mechanical horizontal rack. The document passes beneath it. Papers overlap across a textured desk, beside the booth portrait and an exterior checkpoint strip. Labels are embedded into the physical controls.

*Website use.* Create an original review desk where an object physically aligns with a decision tool. Design the rack, stamp silhouette and outcome mark together; keep clear semantic actions and a direct keyboard path. Author the press and return movement separately.

**desktop endless mode selection**. Sparse white pixel typography sits on black. A dotted contour wraps the selected upper mode, extends downward through an offset neck, and encloses its chosen document-stack illustration. Other stacks remain separate. Wide dotted baseline rules support the lower text actions.

*Website use.* Use an authored stepped contour that joins the selected category to its preview object. The connecting neck can guide the eye across a dispersed page. This is a shape grammar to redraw for the project; a traveling outline would be new motion.

**desktop end-of-day ledger**. A narrow condensed ledger pairs text and amounts in an open black field, with red costs, pale totals and tiny circular toggles. A clipped day plaque anchors a long hairline. Circular family-status seals and a separate left column of upgrade objects frame the central account.

*Website use.* Build a deliberately typeset project receipt with a clipped chapter tab, exact tabular alignment, drawn status seals and separate object controls. Let the paperwork metaphor determine control shapes and spacing rather than applying a generic dashboard.

**Title screen** (0:10, 0:17, 0:24, 0:30). The block-letter title enters from below. As it settles, Story and Endless become visible beneath it. The next screen is mostly black space with a small outlined New box in a day-selection area and Back along the bottom.

*Website use.* Let a publication's masthead make the dramatic entrance, then give each available issue a legible stamped button. Use a real date when it identifies a saved edition.

</details>

`persona-3-reload` · RPG, social simulation

> Three official screenshots cover map selection, battle commands and dialogue. Sampled release footage adds the pause menu, Social Link list-to-detail transition and the classroom title-to-menu reveal.

| Observation | Screen | Evidence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `p3r-map-select-list` map selection | `map` | static_image, high | [Persona 3 Reload official screenshot — Map Select](https://p3re.jp/en/resources/img/top/feature_modal/feature2_ss2_b671e49409555dfc854cf2f2d58f5392.webp) |
| `p3r-battle-command-cluster` combat command overlay | `combat_menu` | static_image, high | [Persona 3 Reload official screenshot — Battle commands](https://p3re.jp/en/resources/img/top/feature_modal/feature2_ss1_b331067ecccb15dd88f1397af612ac3b.webp) |
| `p3r-daily-life-dialogue` daily-life dialogue overlay | `dialogue` | static_image, high | [Persona 3 Reload official screenshot — Daily life dialogue](https://p3re.jp/en/resources/img/top/game_system_modal/dailylife_01_928f62e1a5fef80e2d5e70d48de24d6d.webp) |
| `p3r-social-link-list-to-detail` pause menu and Social Link detail | `pause` | video_frames, high | [RelaxAlax, Pause Menus Shouldn't Be This Good](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PwTS-CcrSjQ) |
| `persona-3-reload-opening-study` Main menu | `main_menu` | video_frames, high | [jokon · Persona 3 Reload · Main menu](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2JjHVOr58-w&t=7s) |

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**map selection**. A deep-blue left list overlays a warm city map. A white row marks the current item. White display text, a large blue location pin, oversized cropped labels, slanted blue corner shapes, and cyan accents establish hierarchy. Date and time occupy the upper right; control hints sit along the lower right.

*Website use.* For a travel directory or portfolio index, use a readable list beside an atmospheric map or preview. Add a single high-contrast selected row, a compact status cluster, and one large display label. Keep diagonal decoration outside reading and focus areas; stack list and preview on mobile.

**combat command overlay**. Large white italic command words cluster around a blue circular shape near the lower left. A large incomplete blue ring curves behind the character. Three portrait-and-meter blocks form a vertical stack on the right. Cyan and yellow meters sit against black angled bases; a red target label occupies the upper left.

*Website use.* For a creator homepage or product hero, borrow the open central canvas, a short emphatic action group, and a narrow status rail. Use normal accessible buttons with clear focus rings; reserve tilted display type for short labels and avoid circular navigation for long menus.

**daily-life dialogue overlay**. A dark navy organic dialogue shape appears near the bottom center over a bright library scene. Blue and lavender outlines surround white text, with a small outlined downward indicator. The upper-right blue date strip uses a large white date, cyan secondary text, and yellow numeric emphasis.

*Website use.* Use a restrained navy callout or contextual help panel over an image, with one blue border accent and readable white copy. Translate the date strip into a compact event or release-status module. Offer solid backgrounds for text and a reduced-motion option if animation is added.

**pause menu and Social Link detail** (9:00, 9:04.64, 9:04.76, 9:04.88, 9:05.24). The root places a leaning column of commands beside a suspended figure. In Social Link, the selected Fool row is visible at 9:04.64. At 9:04.76 the list has cleared and Mitsuru's description appears beside the figure. By 9:04.88 the rank and portraits are in place. At 9:05.24 the protagonist's hand is open beside the card.

*Website use.* For a photography exhibition, keep the identity of the selected print visible as the visitor opens edition details. Reveal the facts while the image finishes reframing. Return to the same print and restore focus to its opening control.

**Main menu** (0:07.50, 0:08.75, 0:09.00, 0:09.25, 0:10.00, 0:10.25, 0:10.50, 0:10.75). The prompt cycles between outline and filled text at the window. It clears as the camera reveals desks. A blue strip precedes three lower-right choices.

*Website use.* Open one gallery room into a contact sheet and anchor the first choice where the camera settles.

</details>

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**character status**. The embedded game screenshot uses a bright yellow field, orange circles, and rounded television-like rectangles. A portrait sits at the lower left beneath compact health and resource meters. A five-axis chart occupies the right, surrounded by five orange labeled circles. Status appears as large white text with a black outline.

*Website use.* For a playful personal dashboard or profile page, combine a clear portrait-and-summary column with an adjacent attribute module. Use a yellow/orange palette and repeated rounded frames. Provide numeric or textual equivalents for charts so essential data does not depend on the radar shape.

**combat commands and party status**. A yellow circular command area sits at the lower left of the embedded game image. Black uppercase commands stack vertically, with a dark horizontal band marking one option. Small portrait-and-meter modules form a right-edge vertical stack. A red-orange strip beneath the menu carries supporting text.

*Website use.* Use a compact high-contrast action list inside a circle-inspired or rounded frame, with a straight selected-row marker. Reuse small status cards as a consistent module. On small screens, turn the composition into a conventional vertical list rather than shrinking the full game interface.

**Main menu** (0:12, 0:16, 0:20, 0:25, 0:32, 0:40). A red start prompt crosses a yellow field around the fixed logo. A violet field carries a settled two-column menu, then the yellow title returns.

*Website use.* Direct motion toward the entrance and hold the actual menu buttons still when the choices appear.

</details>

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**Main-menu icon dock**. A two-row icon dock is anchored low in the scene, with a cyan selected tile. A separate cyan-edged status pane floats at the left; the avatar, architecture, and much of the world remain exposed. Fine luminous borders echo the scene's cyan architectural seams.

*Website use.* Treat site utilities as an instrument dock beneath an explorable project scene. Draw its thin seams using the same geometry as the original environment, with independent selection light and exterior annotations. Keep navigation legible while preserving the subject as the center of the page.

**Item inventory and detail pane**. The inventory is a tall translucent blue-gray window at left with icon tabs and a narrow search/sort rail. Cyan outlines mark the selected row, and a thin yellow strip marks its leading edge. A separate smaller item-detail window floats just to the right while the world and character remain visible.

*Website use.* Build an archive browser as two deliberately offset instruments: a narrow indexed manifest and a contextual specimen pane. Let a small leading-edge signal and an exterior connecting annotation identify the active entry. Author opening and closing as separate pane movements rather than scaling the entire archive.

**Title screen** (2:40, 3:00, 3:35, 4:18). An opening movie yields to a bright valley. The logo and a dark horizontal Press Any Button strip hold in the centre.

*Website use.* Explain the first necessary workspace or account choice with a stable button at the entrance.

</details>

### Sifu

`sifu` · action

> Archived screenshots. Main-menu image visibly carries v_1.5_3.330. Other captures' exact patch/platform is unverified; do not claim current 2026 UI.

| Observation | Screen | Evidence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sifu-main-menu-anatomy` Sifu main-menu type hierarchy | `main_menu` | static_image, high | [Sifu main-menu type hierarchy](https://interfaceingame.com/screenshots/sifu-main-menu/) |
| `sifu-shrine-anatomy` Sifu shrine reward selection | `progression` | static_image, high | [Sifu shrine reward selection](https://interfaceingame.com/screenshots/sifu-skill-tree-2/) |
| `sifu-board-anatomy` Sifu evidence board | `codex` | static_image, high | [Sifu evidence board](https://interfaceingame.com/screenshots/sifu-board/) |
| `sifu-level-anatomy` Sifu level-selection scene | `mode_select` | static_image, high | [Sifu level-selection scene](https://interfaceingame.com/screenshots/sifu-level-selection/) |
| `sifu-opening-study` Main menu | `main_menu` | video_frames, high | [PressStartOnce · Sifu · Main menu](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pUrAgEBkPas&t=53s) |

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**Sifu main-menu type hierarchy**. Four text choices occupy a narrow left column over a dark rainy building scene. The selected first line is heavier and less regular than the thinner remaining labels. Large quiet image space and black letterbox regions frame the list; no enclosing button boxes are visible.

*Website use.* Carry the identity through the reading surface. Cut a shallow recess for each navigation choice, set its name once inside and fill the chosen recess with ink.

**Sifu shrine reward selection**. The image labeled Skill Tree by the gallery actually shows shrine rewards. Three groups of hand-drawn icons sit beneath age, score, and XP thresholds. A broken brush square surrounds the selected icon, with a short stem leading to its caption. A small shrine object floats above a pale field.

*Website use.* Draw each choice on a painted plate beside the illustrated object it affects. A broken brushstroke can spread outside the selected plate while its label and focus outline stay intact. A brush-draw entrance and uneven erase exit are original motion options.

**Sifu evidence board**. Newspaper pieces, portraits, notes, and printed fragments appear over pale silhouettes of still-missing material. A small circular cursor sits among the evidence. A centered text tab bar uses a heavy active word and underline; the board remains the dominant composition.

*Website use.* Develop a process archive as a collected evidence surface: each project artifact has its own contour and place. Use quiet ghost shapes to suggest unfinished paths and a detached selection marker to connect an artifact with its detail. Author navigation across the board without depending on an inaccessible drag-only interface.

**Sifu level-selection scene**. A room's window frames a wide city vista. A location caption sits on the desk near the bottom, with short start and back prompts at the lower right. The world image and architectural frame dominate; there is no grid of destination cards in the capture.

*Website use.* Treat an original scene as the project selector, with a grounded title plate and a purposeful opening action. When a destination changes, coordinate the subject, title, and frame as one authored transition. Determine the actual camera or reveal choreography through new experiments rather than attributing it to this still.

**Main menu** (0:53, 0:54, 0:55, 0:56, 0:57). The PS5 main menu holds New Game, Options and Credits at the left of a rainy building. At 0:55 an exposure flash reveals the upper storeys. It is dark again at 0:56 and New Game remains highlighted in the same place.

*Website use.* For a studio entrance, reserve a stable patch for a high-contrast booking button. Use a continuous gentle rain or still image where flashing would distract.

</details>

`silent-hill-2-2001` · survival horror

> Original-generation PS2 examples credited by Silent Hill Memories; its guide explicitly distinguishes PS2 controls from other ports. Save image visibly identifies GH (Greatest Hits). Do not equate every capture with the initial 2001 build, the PC port, HD Collection, Enhanced Edition, or 2024 remake.

| Observation | Screen | Evidence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `silent-hill-2-2001-inventory-anatomy` Inventory | `inventory` | static_image, high | [Inventory](https://www.silenthillmemories.net/sh2/playing_the_game_en.htm) |
| `silent-hill-2-2001-load-anatomy` Load menu | `save_load` | static_image, high | [Load menu](https://www.silenthillmemories.net/sh2/playing_the_game_en.htm) |
| `silent-hill-2-2001-main-anatomy` Main menu | `title` | static_image, high | [Main menu](https://www.silenthillmemories.net/sh2/playing_the_game_en.htm) |
| `silent-hill-2-2001-opening-study` Main menu | `main_menu` | video_frames, high | [Retro Video Game Footage · Silent Hill 2 (original generation) · Main menu](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CQrshhgnnCk&t=52s) |

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**Inventory**. Objects float in a horizontal line on black. The centered shotgun is isolated by offset open blue corner frames with ammunition beneath. Three top regions separate Status, Equipment and Command, while three blue luminous rules underlie lower utility labels. Rough serif text contrasts with the object renders.

*Website use.* Build an artifact archive as an object shelf with an off-center corner reticle, separate command column and small status viewport. Keep the empty space and authored lettering; invent reticle travel and object handoff rather than copying a standard card carousel.

**Load menu**. A saturated red translucent sheet overlays murky imagery. Rounded header tabs identify two memory slots; thin ruled save rows carry serif titles and compact ending codes. The selected row has amber fill while another brighter row remains distinct. Large metadata is arranged in a lower two-column group.

*Website use.* Create an archive list whose paper-like color field, ruled rows and metadata carry atmosphere. Distinguish saved state from current focus with different marks; do not infer a flashing selection from this single image.

**Main menu**. An enormous distressed wordmark dominates a dark rippled surface. Four small outlined menu labels sit beneath without enclosing boxes; Continue has a soft horizontal glow and New Game is pale yellow. The hierarchy relies on texture, scale and empty space.

*Website use.* For a deliberately atmospheric landing page, make original typography and a continuous material field carry identity. A detached light smear can mark focus while the label stays stable; any flicker or liquid movement would be a new, separately tested choice.

**Main menu** (0:52, 0:56, 1:04, 1:13, 1:24). On PS2, New Game and Option sit below a textured title. A pale oblong marks the current word. The new-game setup exposes Action Level and Riddle Level side by side. The separate options page leads to its own brightness calibration screen.

*Website use.* For an escape-room booking, introduce puzzle and physical difficulty only once the visitor chooses an experience. Give each choice its own readable surface.

</details>

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**main mode selector**. The screen is divided into three tall adjoining panels rather than a row of framed cards.,World Tour uses irregular yellow graffiti on cyan; the center uses a dark geometric emblem on white facets; Fighting Ground uses thin tall neon lettering over a dense purple marked wall.,The three destinations differ in material and lettering, not just accent color.

*Website use.* Give the top-level branches of a creative site distinct drawn title treatments inside one shared full-height partition. Use the same navigation semantics while letting each destination announce a different world. Motion between them still requires its own prototype.

**multi menu**. Twelve dark icon tiles form two rows; opposing clipped corners give each tile a cut sheet silhouette.,The selected CFN tile is pale and faceted, with a thin bright blue vertical strip outside its left edge.,A longer Main Menu control below reuses the cut-corner language, while helper copy remains detached near the lower left.

*Website use.* Create a coherent cut-sheet family whose active art includes a detached seam outside the stable hit area. Carry the same contour into long controls, compact tiles and focus treatment rather than designing a one-off decorative hover.

**arcade stage progression**. A large fighter occupies the left and overlaps a glowing purple world-map composition.,A destination image floats in a bright double frame at the upper right with a country label above.,Small slanted opponent tiles and unknown slots form a route at the lower center beneath a Stage 1 marker.

*Website use.* For a multi-step project journey, place the current chapter in a dramatic scene and show the route as a separate compact strip. Let frame art and route glyphs connect through a shared slant; do not reduce the whole page to a progress bar above cards.

**status skill list**. The character remains visible behind a translucent blue skill list and an opaque cream detail sheet.,The selected row is yellow with angular streaks at its right end; equipment markers occupy clipped green upper-left corners of rows.,The cream detail sheet has an angled header split and occupies a separate right column.

*Website use.* For a bespoke editor, keep the project visible behind task controls and use a visually different detail sheet to explain the selected operation. Design corner markers, row art and explanatory panels as one family; any entry/exit choreography remains a new proposal.

**Title screen** (0:20, 0:30, 0:40, 0:45, 0:50, 0:55). A dark field isolates the white logotype and orange mark. Press Any Button is visible at 0:40. A few seconds later two fighters occupy the whole screen in a demonstration. The playable action is legible even at thumbnail size.

*Website use.* Give a dance or sport portfolio a short demonstration of the work. Keep its labelled entrance available while it plays and on the still poster frame.

</details>

Illustrated lanterns, crowds and stalls compose the whole background.

*Website use.* Treat primary navigation as a theatrical poster with original character cutouts and an explanation shelf, while secondary actions remain compact rails. Maintain coherent ink weight, silhouette and festival-like page composition instead of adding unrelated decoration to ordinary buttons.

**Main menu** (0:29, 0:30, 0:34, 0:35, 0:36, 0:37, 0:40). The L + R Start cue appears between the mascots and logo. The screen darkens, fireworks play, a festival scene appears and the selected mode unfolds above compact neighbouring buttons.

A wide translucent dark overlay spans the upper left and partially covers the enlarged selected character.,A single tall costume portrait sits at the overlay left; pink up/down chevrons float near its horizontal center.,The dense roster is centered low; a pink portrait selection and large italic REINA label make identity visible at two scales.

**versus matchup**. Kuma and Jun use dramatically different illustrated treatments on opposing halves.,Oversized brush lettering sits behind the figures, while a narrow bright VS cuts across the central seam.,Two small bordered stat panels sit in front at the bottom; a tiny stage image occupies the low center.

**main menu**. A large Kazuya portrait fills the center-right. Pink marks the Online tab and selected row; utility icons occupy the lower left and a promotional tile sits lower right.

*Website use.* Build a campaign or portfolio scene around one oversized subject with compact navigation anchored away from the face. Let the selected row reveal a second plane of choices while retaining the parent highlight.

**main menu to Options transition** (0:11.500, 0:11.600, 0:12.300, 0:12.400, 0:12.500, 0:12.550, 0:12.650). 11.500: outgoing menu dims; 11.600: only the sharp character scene remains.,12.300: faint Options rows and a pink title block appear. 12.400: the dark panel is present while the title remains covered.,12.500: part of Options emerges and a short pink row begins. 12.550: the title is readable, its block is a narrow leading rule, and row fill extends partway. 12.650: selection spans the panel over a softened portrait.

*Website use.* Original proposal: choreograph a website route as a deliberate clean-scene beat, followed by a type-cover gesture and a selection stroke that travels across its own plane. Make title and control artwork related but independently timed. Replace the game’s rectangles with original geometry where the project calls for it; keep entry/exit and interrupted navigation explicitly specified.

**Main menu** (0:30, 0:43, 0:49, 0:54, 1:00). The title puts Kazuya's shadowed face on the left and the logo on the right. A dark connection message occupies the centre. At the main menu, the face is reframed to the right of the destination list. A saturated red bar marks Story under a row of tabs.

*Website use.* Crop a portrait differently for the entrance and the working menu. Reserve the free side for the current decision, including the longest label at phone width.

</details>

### Warframe

`warframe` · cooperative action, action RPG

| Observation | Screen | Evidence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `wf-origin-system-destinations` Origin System overview | `map` | static_image, high | [Digital Extremes — The Star Chart, system overview](https://www.warframe.com/en/news/star-chart) |
| `wf-desdemona-node-brief` Desdemona mission node details | `mode_select` | static_image, high | [Digital Extremes — PC Update 36, Suggested Damage on Desdemona](https://www.warframe.com/en/patch-notes/pc/36-0-0) |
| `wf-navigation-inline-loadout` Equipment options inside Navigation | `loadout` | static_image, high | [Digital Extremes — PC Update 36, Warframe options in Navigation](https://www.warframe.com/en/patch-notes/pc/36-0-0) |
| `wf-icebind-squad-deployment` The Icebind group mission vote, PC Update 44.1 | `confirmation` | static_image, high | [Digital Extremes — PC Update 44.1, voting on a Cryobell in The Icebind](https://www.warframe.com/en/patch-notes/pc/44-1-0) |
| `warframe-opening-study` Title screen | `title` | static_image, high | [Digital Extremes · Warframe · Title screen](https://www.warframe.com/en/patch-notes/pc/37-0-0) |
| `warframe-login-to-tribute` Sign-in to the daily tribute choice | `confirmation` | video_frames, high | [Dan Robson Game · Warframe · Confirmation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2gH1GpDrAfM&t=17s) |

<details><summary>Read the control and scene studies</summary>

**Origin System overview**. Widely spaced white destination names sit beside bodies of different sizes against dark space. A kneeling figure sits behind the chart. Thin arcs cross the field. Small dark-and-gold utility groups sit at the corners.

*Website use.* Use a venue floor plan for a festival with multiple stages. Give each stage a labeled position and an illustration drawn from its actual architecture. Reveal its programme on selection.

**Desdemona mission node details**. A gold diamond and Desdemona label sit below a rectangular preview above the planet. The panel layers a location name over scene art. Below it are the mission type, Grineer faction, level range 26–28 and a Suggested Damage row with two symbols. Nearby node names remain visible.

*Website use.* Choose a workshop on a programme map to reveal an actual work sample, the session title, duration and prerequisite. Keep the parent venue visible and open the full syllabus on request.

**Equipment options inside Navigation**. A vertical strip of equipment icons occupies the left edge. Beside the Excalibur thumbnail a narrow dark panel shows Swap, Upgrade and three configurations, with a check beside Config A. Named destinations and their connecting lines remain in view across the middle.

*Website use.* Let a visitor switch their existing ticket or selected date in a local panel while the session they are considering stays visible. Show the applied value when the panel closes.

**The Icebind group mission vote, PC Update 44.1**. Six mission columns repeat type, planet, faction and modifiers in the same order. Four player emblems overlap the top of the frost-edged Pluto option. The shared countdown is centered below the row and the personal modifier occupies a separate area below it.

*Website use.* For a group scheduling brief, attach participant votes to actual session options and keep the viewer's availability separate. Give the organizer an explicit final booking action.

**Title screen**. A seated Warframe occupies the left of the login composition. On the right, the logo sits over credentials and Login. Login with Steam forms a second wide surface, with a much smaller Auto Login choice immediately beneath.

*Website use.* Use a recognisable work or avatar as the stable subject beside sign-in. Keep the service-specific sign-in action visibly distinct and put the remember option with the account controls. Take returning people straight to their work.

**Sign-in to the daily tribute choice** (0:17, 0:20, 0:28, 0:31, 0:53, 0:55, 1:02, 1:10). The Orphix Venom sign-in dims and a geometric wait indicator appears beneath it. The same space reveals a daily tribute with three named items. With the cursor over Azima, its tile gains an outline and a description opens to its right. Over Zenith the description sits to the left of that tile.

*Website use.* For a saved material selection, keep the objects fixed while their previews open on the side with enough room. On a narrow display put the preview below the row and provide a separate confirmation for the lasting choice.

</details>
